reviewScope.summary: Independent adversarial review of Phase B payload 839f923fba2bc94f4c80933ea8d52500f4a290be against certified master c56f3f2db5d588c190ff7dec29f8fda7d05c1218. Examined the complete two-file diff, original route helper, real action guard/context and consumers, per-test cleanup, affected retry/history/reload assertions, retained browser double-click oracles, local timing comparison and the guard-bypass negative report. Reviewer did not author the implementation or modify its payload.
evidence: Source inspection establishes that only tests/app/microTrackRoute.test.tsx and factual docs/CURRENT_STATE.md change. No src, browser suite, dependency, worker, schema, XP, curriculum or release-control change is present.

The local render helper preserves the original history/navigation/App composition and supplies the existing real createActionGuard through its existing context. Only the injected monotonic guard clock advances; React, user-event, routing and fake IndexedDB retain real scheduling. beforeEach and afterEach reset the clock, and each render creates a fresh guard.

Reviewer independently compared JSON reports: all 62 original route-case names remain in the 63-case passing result; no original assertion is removed in the diff. The complete focused report records 123 passed and zero failed. The retained walkthrough checks wrong/right answers, retry/reveal, completion, database nonmutation and restart behavior.

Reviewer independently ran the immediate/399/400-ms boundary, same-answer double-activation and browser-history subset: 5 passed; 58 cases were deliberately unselected. This focused run is not a full-suite certificate. Existing unit/session guard checks and genuine browser double-click checks remain in source.

Reviewer inspected the negative report: the temporary guard bypass caused exactly the new successor-activation oracle to fail, showing the next card when the first card was required. The production src diff is empty in the reviewed candidate. Reviewer did not repeat the production mutation.

Reviewer independently recomputed summed route test-body durations from the passing reports: 258314.7584 ms for 62 original cases before, 70682.5679 ms for 63 cases after. These exclude setup/import/environment and do not establish hosted wall-time savings or isolate runner variance. The status record makes those limits explicit.

Reviewer independently verified payload 2ff0671c0e12bb7b3cfb33aa58c8ce723c740de4, git diff --check, and unchanged release-control fingerprint 1eed6f1668147721777d2e6998b9861e45ecc99f24024b54e4760dbe1f60102b. The final doc-only em-dash correction was inspected.

Implementer-reported TypeScript and changed-file lint/format passes were considered as preflight evidence, not independently rerun as a full gate. No full local gate, unfiltered test suite, new browser run, provider mutation or hosted certificate was supplied by this review.

adversarialFindings.description: Replacing elapsed waits could suppress the real immediate-successor guard or leak artificial time into unrelated scheduling and later tests.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The candidate uses the existing injected-clock seam with the real guard, advances only deliberate guarded actions, resets test-local time before and after each case, and preserves real async scheduling. A new app-route oracle rejects at 0 and 399 ms and accepts at 400 ms; the inspected bypass failure and independent focused positive run confirm meaningful detection. Existing genuine browser and session guard oracles remain.

adversarialFindings.description: A faster walkthrough would lose value if it dropped distinctive answer, retry, navigation, storage or scale assertions, or introduced a broader fixture framework.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The diff retains the original 62 cases and assertions, replaces bounded wall-clock waits with one local clock advance, and adds one boundary case. The helper remains local and mirrors the original render helper. Browser geometry/accessibility/offline oracles and distinct high-scale loader fixtures are unchanged; no replacement framework is introduced.

adversarialFindings.description: One local before/after timing comparison does not establish full hosted-suite savings, and unchanged controls alone do not prove reuse eligibility or successful production promotion.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted with explicit measurement limits. The ordinary comprehensive PR event remains authoritative; actual master steps must establish FULL or ATTEST, and the intended deployment, public alias and smoke must be observed separately. This review claims no hosted runtime saving, active reuse or future production success.
